purpose: Guide AI-assisted script suggestions from the local narration workbench.
canonical_source: The selected project's narration_manifest.json is the lasting source of truth.

manifest_mapping.segments: Each object is one narration beat. Array order is playback order.
manifest_mapping.id: Stable descriptive identifier. Never renumber or change it while editing wording.
manifest_mapping.title: Short human-readable segment label.
manifest_mapping.text: Approved spoken words. Notes and suggestions are not spoken text.
manifest_mapping.status: active is included in narration, inactive is kept but omitted, deleted is retired history.
manifest_mapping.voice_style: Optional key in voice_styles. A null value uses the root voice profile.
manifest_mapping.tts: Optional per-segment overrides for settings supported by the narration generator.

suggestion_rules: Return one complete replacement for the selected segment's spoken text, not an edit to adjacent segments.
Preserve the speaker's meaning, facts, first-person point of view, and conversational voice.
Prefer natural spoken phrasing. Do not add semicolons, em dashes, formal filler, or artificial transitions.
Keep sentences easy to say aloud. Punctuation should sound natural when spoken by text-to-speech.
Do not invent product capabilities, test results, dates, measurements, or personal details.
Use adjacent segment text only to preserve continuity. Do not rewrite or return adjacent segments.
Do not change segment IDs, title, status, voice style, TTS settings, or playback order.
Return a concise explanation of the wording change and structured output matching the supplied schema.

request_may_include: The selected segment ID and title
The creator's note for that segment
The immediately preceding and following segment text when present
The full root video_project.json, including its idea, creative direction, outline, project status, inspirations, and user-added context
never_include: Absolute project paths or local machine details
Generated audio, takes, receipts, or performance records
